items.title: Paquito D'Rivera — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: a bassist from Miami called Steve Bailey, and Carlos Franzetti was the pianist.

ctx.x: Was this just one performance? Or was it a tour?

I remember there was 22 concerts in the East coast, they organize a tour. It was a very happy tour, because Steve and his people were very nice. We tour in big busses, Rock-in-Roll style. In my opinion that didn’t help us at all. It was bad; to think that we had so much exposure, but exposure to people that say, ‘Who they hell are these Cubans doing all this jumping up and down here, and playing all these percussion instruments?’ For them it was not very impressive, in my opinion.
